transform.expr: datum.usual >= 10 && datum.a0 < datum.usual * 0.25 ? 'act' : datum.usual >= 10 && datum.a0 < datum.usual * 0.5 ? 'warn' : 'ok'
datum.s0 >= 10 && datum.rate0 > 3 * datum.baseRate ? 'act' : datum.s0 >= 5 && datum.rate0 > 2 * datum.baseRate ? 'warn' : 'ok'
datum.name + ': ' + datum.a0 + ' in 24h vs usual ' + round(datum.usual)
datum.name + ': ' + datum.s0 + ' system exceptions (' + format(datum.rate0 * 100, '.1f') + '%' + ' vs usual ' + format(datum.baseRate * 100, '.1f') + '%' + ')'

datum.usual >= 10 && datum.w0 < datum.usual * 0.25 ? 'act' : svInHours && datum.gapX && datum.gapH > 4 ? 'act' : svInHours && datum.gapX && datum.gapH > 2 ? 'warn' : datum.usual >= 10 && datum.w0 < datum.usual * 0.5 ? 'warn' : 'ok'

datum.name + ': last item ' + (datum.ageMin < 90 ? round(datum.ageMin) + ' min' : datum.ageMin < 2880 ? round(datum.ageMin / 60) + ' h' : round(datum.ageMin / 1440) + ' days') + ' ago, ' + datum.w0 + ' in 24h vs usual ' + round(datum.usual)

datum.name + ': ' + (datum.past ? datum.past + ' past SLA' : datum.soon + ' due within 2 h') + ', oldest ' + (datum.ageMin < 90 ? round(datum.ageMin) + ' min' : datum.ageMin < 2880 ? round(datum.ageMin / 60) + ' h' : round(datum.ageMin / 1440) + ' days')

datum.name + ': ' + datum.stuck + ' locked, longest ' + (datum.lockMin < 90 ? round(datum.lockMin) + ' min' : datum.lockMin < 2880 ? round(datum.lockMin / 60) + ' h' : round(datum.lockMin / 1440) + ' days')

values.name: Data arriving
values.runbook: Check the Logstash pipeline is running and can reach the Blue Prism database. If Blue Prism itself has stopped, raise it with platform support.
values.headline: 3 min since the last update

values.name: Cost pipelines up to date
values.runbook: Check the ia-cost-daily Logstash pipeline ran (01:30 UTC by default) and read the Logstash log for the day that failed. Re-run it, then ia-cost-stamp. Value and cost figures are understated until it catches up.
values.headline: Costed to today

values.name: All queues mapped
values.runbook: A queue is producing items that reference data doesn't know, so they are missing from every figure. Add it to queueMap in reference.json (or retire the queue) and reload.
values.headline: Every queue is in reference data

values.name: Nothing past its SLA
values.runbook: Open the queue in Control Room. Check its schedule is running and has a worker; prioritise the items closest to their SLA or add capacity.
values.headline: 145 waiting, 41 past SLA
values.detail: INVEST_REBALANCE: 7 past SLA, oldest 32 h; LEND_APPLICATIONS: 5 past SLA, oldest 29 h; +12 more

values.name: No items stuck on a lock
values.runbook: A session probably died holding the lock. Confirm nothing is running against the item, then unlock it in Control Room.
values.headline: No items locked over 60 min

values.name: Workers running
values.runbook: Log on to the VDI. Check the runtime resource is up, the session isn't stuck on a dialog and the schedule fired.
values.headline: 9 workers active

values.name: Processes running as usual
values.runbook: Check the schedule fired and that items were loaded upstream. An empty queue usually means the feed or the trigger failed.
values.headline: 14 processes on their usual pattern

values.name: System exceptions normal
values.runbook: Read the top reason for the process. It is usually a target system outage, a credential change or a screen change; pause the schedule if items are failing in bulk.
values.headline: 1 process above usual
values.detail: Insurance New Business: 6 system exceptions (12.0% vs usual 3.7%)

values.name: No new exception reasons
values.runbook: A reason not seen in 28 days usually means the target system changed. Check with its owners; if the reason is genuine, add a pattern to reference data.
values.headline: None

text.signal: 'Checked ' + utcFormat(svNow, '%H:%M UTC, %a %d %b') + ' · live checks, five also raise Kibana alerts'
